snippet.title: HomePlanet Trailer
snippet.description:
PLEASE READ THE DESCRITPION !

A trailer for an , unfortunately , unreleased game - HomePlanet . It was pretty difficult for me to get this trailer , so I decided to upload it here for you all to see it . And for it not to be lost in the void of the internet . Sorry , but it's in Russian language .

The game has pretty good graphics ( for a year 2001 game ) . The gameplay is nice too . It has newtonian styled movement in it .

You can download the game demo from places like FilePlanet , or other few sites . The demo is in beta stage , so has bugs . Too bad the full game wasn't released .

Enjoy

P.S. I think it has SOME resemblance to Tarr Chronicles .
